mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is at or below 0.5%, the S&P 500 exhibits positive 20-day forward returns due to accommodative monetary policy compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS level is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.5% within the past month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative 5-day S&P 500 returns due to immediate risk-off sentiment and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5% over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC for UNRATE threshold is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) below their respective 12-month moving averages signals a contraction in the real economy, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns due to reduced business investment and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both INDPRO and HOUST are below their 12-month moving averages over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (defined by FEDFUNDS rising above 2.0% and CPIAUCSL YoY change above 2.0%), the S&P 500 exhibits negative 60-day returns due to reduced liquidity, higher borrowing costs, and increased risk aversion.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.0 and CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.0% over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When residential fixed investment (RSAFS) is above its 12-month moving average, it signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns due to elevated business investment and consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS > 12-month moving average over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC for RSAFS level is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (the 2017 base index), it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative 5-day S&P 500 returns due to immediate concerns about economic slowdown and reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100 over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC for INDPRO threshold is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns due to heightened recession fears and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE > 5.0% over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market booms (defined by HOUST above 1050 and CPIAUCSL YoY change below 2.0%), the S&P 500 exhibits positive 60-day returns due to strong consumer spending, rising home equity, and increased economic activity.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 1050 and CPIAUCSL YoY change < 2.0% over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.03.
